items.exampleEn: We vote for our class leader.
The bank is on the corner.
This is a nice spot for a picnic.
My uncle has a farm with many cows.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔有一座養了很多牛的農場。

items.exampleEn: The station is two blocks from here.
There is an old bridge over the river.

items.audioEn: The cafe is two blocks from here, on the corner.
items.audioZh: 咖啡店離這裡兩個街區，就在轉角。

items.sentenceEn: This is my favorite spot in the park.
items.sentenceZh: 這是我在公園裡最喜歡的地方。

items.stemEn: A ____ grows vegetables on a farm.

items.passageEn: My grandfather is a farmer. His farm is near a small river. To get there, you go over an old stone bridge. There is a big tree in the corner of the farm. It is my favorite spot. I like to sit there and read.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺是農夫。他的農場在一條小河附近，要去那裡得經過一座老石橋。農場的角落有一棵大樹，那是我最喜歡的地方。我喜歡坐在那裡看書。

questions.questionZh: 說話者最喜歡的地方是哪裡？

referenceEn: The station is three blocks from here.
The station is three blocks away.
rubricZh: 「離這裡」可用 from here、away 等

items.instructionZh: 用 farm 造一個句子，說說農場上有什麼，或你去農場的經驗。
referenceEn: There are many cows on the farm.
I visited a farm with my family.
rubricZh: 「在農場上」常用 on the farm；說去農場可用 visit a farm、go to a farm 等
時態配合內容（例如過去的經驗用過去式 visited）
